7 prompts that turn ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok into your spreadsheet assistant. Save this for your next Excel session 📊

#ai #chatgpt #claude #excel #productivity #aitools

slides.title: 7 AI prompts that do your spreadsheet work for you
slides.sub: Copy, paste, save hours every week.
slides.voiceover: Here are seven AI prompts that do your spreadsheet work for you.

slides.name: The Spreadsheet Fixer
slides.title: Turn messy data into a clean table
slides.sub: Raw notes, exports or copied web tables become spreadsheet-ready.
slides.prompt: Clean up the data below. Remove duplicates, standardize dates to [YYYY-MM-DD], split full names into first and last name, and return it as a table with these columns: [COLUMNS]. Then list every change you made.
slides.tip: Send a small sample first and check the result before pasting everything.
slides.voiceover: One. Paste in messy data, and get a clean table back.

slides.name: The Formula Writer
slides.title: Get the exact formula you need
slides.sub: No more searching forums for the right function.
slides.prompt: Write an Excel formula that [GOAL]. Column A contains [DATA A] and column B contains [DATA B], starting in row 2. Explain how it works step by step, then give me the Google Sheets version too.
slides.tip: Name your columns and the row where the data starts. Precision = correct formulas.
slides.voiceover: Two. Describe your goal, and get the exact formula.

slides.name: The Error Detective
slides.title: Fix #N/A, #VALUE! and #REF! fast
slides.sub: Understand the error instead of guessing.
slides.prompt: This formula returns [ERROR]: [PASTE FORMULA]. Here are a few sample rows: [DATA]. Explain why it fails, give me the corrected formula, and tell me how to prevent this error in the future.
slides.tip: Always include sample rows. Errors often come from the data, not the formula.
slides.voiceover: Three. Share the error and a few rows. It finds what broke.

slides.name: The Pivot Planner
slides.title: Build the right pivot table first time
slides.sub: Start from the question, not from the menu.
slides.prompt: My table has these columns: [COLUMNS]. I want to answer this question: [QUESTION]. Tell me exactly how to build the pivot table: what goes in rows, columns, values and filters, and which calculation to use.
slides.tip: Ask for 2 alternative layouts, then pick the one that reads best.
slides.voiceover: Four. Start with your question, and it plans the pivot table.

slides.name: The Chart Picker
slides.title: Choose the chart that tells the story
slides.sub: The wrong chart hides your best numbers.
slides.prompt: Here is my data: [DATA]. I want to show [MESSAGE] to [AUDIENCE]. Which chart type works best and why? Then give me step-by-step instructions to build and format it in [Excel / Google Sheets].
slides.tip: Tell it who will see the chart. A CEO and a team lead need different visuals.
slides.voiceover: Five. Name your audience, and it picks the right chart.

slides.name: The Insight Finder
slides.title: Let AI read your numbers like an analyst
slides.sub: Trends, outliers and next steps in plain language.
slides.prompt: Analyze this data like a senior analyst. Find the 3 most important trends, flag any unusual values, and suggest what I should investigate next. Use plain language and keep it under 200 words.
slides.tip: If your AI tool supports file uploads, attach the spreadsheet directly.
slides.voiceover: Six. Let it read your numbers like an analyst.

slides.name: The Automation Builder
slides.title: Automate the task you repeat every week
slides.sub: Macros and scripts, even if you've never coded.
slides.prompt: Write a [VBA macro / Google Apps Script] that [TASK]. Comment every step, then tell me exactly where to paste it, how to run it, and how to undo it if something goes wrong.
slides.tip: Always test scripts on a copy of your file, never on the original.
slides.voiceover: Seven. Automate weekly chores with a macro, even if you've never coded.
